title: Silver Rewards Card: How to Earn 4% Cash Back on Travel and Software Purchases
summary: This document explains how to earn the Silver Rewards Card’s enhanced 4.0% cash back on eligible travel and software transactions by using the card directly, confirming the merchant’s submitted travel/software (SaaS) category, and waiting for transactions to post (not authorization). It also lists typical non-qualifying charges (e.g., gift cards, P2P payments, fees, interest, bank charges for insurance premiums) and notes rewards are reversed for returned/refunded purchases; misclassified transactions may require receipts/invoices during a rewards review.
